header.title: HeroQuest: The Trial
header.author: RobOS Tabletop Studio
header.description: The Emperor calls upon the kingdom's greatest champions to defeat the armies of Morcar and the Witch Lord.

spells.name: Heal Body
spells.description: Restores up to 4 lost Body Points to any Hero, including yourself.

spells.name: Pass Through Rock
spells.description: Allows the caster or ally to move through solid stone walls on their next turn.

spells.name: Rock Skin
spells.description: Hardens the caster's skin, granting +1 extra Combat Defend Die until damaged.

spells.name: Ball of Flame
spells.description: Hurls a blazing sphere dealing 2 BP damage. Target defends with 2 dice.

spells.name: Courage
spells.description: Fills a hero with magical bravado, granting +2 extra Combat Attack Dice until no monsters remain.

spells.name: Fire of Wrath
spells.description: Strikes any visible monster with darts of flame, causing 1 BP damage. Target defends with 1 die.

spells.name: Water of Healing
spells.description: Restores up to 4 lost Body Points to any Hero.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Puts a monster into magical slumber. It cannot move or attack until it rolls a 6 to wake up.

spells.name: Veil of Mist
spells.description: Envelops the caster in thick fog, allowing movement unseen past monsters.

spells.name: Genie
spells.description: Summons an ancient djinn to attack any visible monster with 5 combat dice, or to open any locked door.

spells.name: Swift Wind
spells.description: Bestows the speed of the tempest, allowing the hero to roll double movement dice (4d6).

spells.name: Tempest
spells.description: Creates a localized vortex trapping a monster for 1 turn. It misses its next turn.

storyTriggers.title: The Emperor's Hidden Epistle
storyTriggers.narrative: Stop. Do not draw a card. As your hand searches along the cold damp wall behind the dragon skull altar, a loose mortar stone gives way! Inside a hollow recess lies a velvet-wrapped pouch containing 50 gold pieces and an urgent letter bearing the Emperor's royal seal: 'Champions of the Realm: Beware the foul Orc Warlord Verag in his catacombs. Take this gold to steel your courage and vanquish the gathering storm.'
storyTriggers.consequence: The hero does not draw a treasure card. Instead, they receive 50 Gold Coins and the Emperor's Epistle.

item.name: Letter from the Emperor
item.description: An urgent parchment bearing the Emperor's royal wax crest, calling for Verag's defeat.

storyTriggers.title: Restless Dead of the Catacomb
storyTriggers.narrative: As your boot crosses the stone threshold into the crypt, an icy draft chills you to the marrow! A hollow, mocking laughter echoes from the ceiling vaults as the heavy flagstones rattle. An ancient Crypt Skeleton bursts from the earth, scythe raised in deadly fury!
storyTriggers.consequence: AMBUSH! 1 Crypt Skeleton bursts from the floor tiles and enters the fray!

specialTreasure.title: Dragon Skull Altar Hoard
specialTreasure.description: Beneath the dragon skull altar lies a velvet pouch containing 100 Gold Coins!
specialTreasure.flavor: Unclaimed loot from fallen adventurers of ages past.

specialTreasure.title: Ancient Crypt Stone Chest
specialTreasure.description: An ancient stone chest contains 50 Gold Coins.
specialTreasure.flavor: Carved with the runes of the ancient kings, the heavy stone lid gives way to reveal a cache of gold.

specialTreasure.title: Armory Weapons Chest
specialTreasure.description: Inside a reinforced weapons chest, you find a Potion of Healing and 30 Gold Coins.
specialTreasure.flavor: Left behind by the garrison, this sealed elixir restores up to 4 Body Points.

specialTreasure.title: Hidden Vault Strongbox
specialTreasure.description: A magnificent gilded chest contains 150 Gold Coins!
specialTreasure.flavor: The secret vault guarded by the hidden doorway yields its grand prize.

heroquest-lair-orc-warlord.title: Quest 3: Lair of the Orc Warlord

heroquest-fortress-fire-king.title: Quest 4: The Fortress of the Fire King (First Light Side A)

storyTriggers.title: Encounter on the Perimeter
storyTriggers.narrative: An orc and a goblin, wearing Cassandria's pale-skull-and-ruby-eyes emblem, haul a heavy ironbound treasure chest along the corridor. On seeing you, the orc panics and heaves the chest straight through a crumbling false wall into the darkness!

storyTriggers.title: Chamber of Mist & Undeath
storyTriggers.narrative: Freezing gray mist curls across the flagstones. High above the hearth, a Witch Hand of Cassandria chants in a forgotten tongue. Skeletons and mummies step silently from the vapor—and through the very stone walls themselves!

specialTreasure.title: Weapons Cache
specialTreasure.description: Hero searches the weapons rack and keeps the least expensive of 4 dealt equipment cards.
specialTreasure.flavor: Cassandria's scouts abandoned their gathered supplies in haste.

rooms.name: Guard Post (Note C: Cassandria's Doomguard)
rooms.description: Station of the Dread Warrior elite Doomguard guarding the approaches.

rooms.name: The Grand Hearth Hall (Note F: Witch Hand Summoning)
rooms.event: A Witch Hand begins casting; undead emerge from swirling mist with the stench of undeath.
rooms.special: Undead in this room may move through walls into areas already discovered by the heroes.

specialTreasure.title: Orc's Bane & Stashed Gold

itemData.name: Orc's Bane
itemData.effect: Shortsword that grants 2 attacks per turn against any Orc.

specialTreasure.description: Concealed within a hollowed wall panel lies 200 Gold Coins and the fabled blade Orc's Bane!

rooms.name: Twin Vault West (Note D)
rooms.special: Door to adjoining room is already open; reveal both rooms.

rooms.name: Twin Vault East (Note D)
rooms.special: Adjoining room revealed simultaneously when Twin Vault West is opened.

rooms.name: Southwest Crypt (Unlettered Encounter)
rooms.description: Ancient dwarven ossuary containing 3 restless skeletons.

rooms.name: Southwest Guard Room (Unlettered Encounter)
rooms.description: Garrison quarters harboring greenskin raiders (2 Goblins, 1 Orc).

rooms.name: Throne Room of the Fire King (Note G)
rooms.special: Secret door to the mountain passage cannot be discovered by a normal search.

specialTreasure.title: Glordrin's Map of the Passage
specialTreasure.description: A secret compartment inside the dwarven desk contains Glordrin's map of the passage; places the secret door.

secondSearch.description: Beneath a false bottom in the iron chest lies 400 Gold Coins and the Ring of Fortitude!

furniture.name: Hearth of Forgrin the Fire King

quests.title: Quest 1: The Trial
quests.briefing: You have learned well, my apprentices. Now comes your final test. Seek out the foul Orc Warlord Verag in his hidden catacombs, slay him, and return to the stairwell alive.

quests.title: Quest 2: The Rescue of Sir Ragnar
quests.briefing: Sir Ragnar, one of the Emperor's most trusted knights, has been captured by the Greenskins. Infiltrate the fortress prison, locate his cell, and escort him safely to the surface.

quests.title: Quest 3: Lair of the Orc Warlord
quests.briefing: Deep within the sunken caverns lies the seat of the Orc Chieftain Ulag. Purge his foul guards, shatter his command throne, and reclaim the stolen royal treasure.

quests.title: Quest 4: The Fortress of the Fire King
quests.briefing: Mentor examines Visions of King Agrain, a book recovered from the temple. Sir Ragnar takes the book to deliver to Prince Magnus. Mentor sends the heroes beyond the Tul Vor to find the secret passage into the mountain in the ruins of the dwarven fortress built by Forgrin the Fire King, warning that Witch Queen Cassandria seeks it too.
